replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, math often makes me anxious. It's one of my least favorite subjects, and my low conscientiousness makes it hard to focus. I avoid complex math when possible.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried AI for math last year, but it was confusing. My high neuroticism made me doubt its answers, so I stuck to what I knew. It didn't help much.
